parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM user group.

parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram detach-policy-from-group --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --group-name dev --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ram DetachPolicyFromGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName dev --PolicyType Custom --ResourceGroupId 'example-string' --PolicyName 'OSS-Administrator'
